theme: Large rounded basalt boulders with broad softly faceted faces, a low layered mound in the left third and a smaller cluster toward the right. Sparse small scoria nodules between them.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: CLOSE BACKGROUND ROCK BAND A for Cinderheart Caldera, immediately behind playable terrain.
Reference image supplies biome materials, colour and hand-drawn cave style. Create only a transparent-bottom-layer scenery band, NOT a scene or full wall.
Very wide horizontal 4:1 composition. A continuous ground-attached band of substantial overlapping volcanic rock formations, filling the lower part; upper area is genuine TRANSPARENCY. Large rounded basalt boulders with broad softly faceted faces, a low layered mound in the left third and a smaller cluster toward the right. Sparse small scoria nodules between them.
Different rock sizes and varied irregular height, dimensional chunky volumes, dark contact crevices and restrained broad rim highlights. Visible dark charcoal/burgundy and muted mauve shading; NOT a flat black silhouette. Slightly dimmer and softer than playable terrain so the play layer reads in front. Thin dark hand-drawn outlines and simple broad painted facets like the reference. Only a few extremely faint ember hairline cracks; NO bright molten lava, glow, plants, leaves, roots, bones, crystals, architecture, floor slabs, walkable ledges or characters.
Tallest rocks reach about 65–75% of image height, leaving a clear transparent upper band. Full-width connected rock base flush with bottom. At both vertical ends keep similarly LOW rounded rubble, no large rocks touching the side edges, no vertical borders, no side margins. The base should be visually compatible for horizontal looping. Opaque rock bodies, transparent outside the silhouettes. No text, grid, watermark or checkerboard. Production layer PNG only.
